Functions $h$ and $f$ are graphed.

![Function h is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, 1), moves upward to (negative 2, 4), moves downward to (negative 1, 2), moves upward to (0, 4), moves downward and ends at (4, 0).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/2b3bdd4dfd40eabdfeacdac4441945d43650db0d) ![Function f is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments and a closed circle. The set starts at (negative 4, 6), moves downward to (negative 2, 2), moves upward through an open circle at (negative 1, 4) to (0, 6), moves downward to (1, 2), moves horizontally to the right and ends at (4, 2). The closed circle is plotted at (negative 1, 2).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/67587f75f31d547ffd30ddd1ff3e22b0f699c8bc)

**Find $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to -1}\Big(h(x)f(x)\Big)$.**

[[☃ radio 1]]
